pivots.why: Expanded from the toolbar to a purpose-built agent per the July 25, 2025 company announcement

target_customer: Software engineers and companies adopting AI coding agents; later businesses deploying autonomous AI coworkers
problem: Frontend developers had to describe UI elements to coding agents by hand; later, teams want autonomous agent workers.
business_model: Open core (AGPLv3 core) with commercial cloud inference and enterprise offerings
product_category: Developer tools: browser toolbar, agentic IDE, AI coworkers

founders.name: Glenn Töws
education: DHBW Mosbach, electrical engineering (dual study with Rheinmetall)
founders.background_notes: Per YC page, embedded software componentization work at Miele.

founders.name: Julian Goetze
founders.background_notes: YC bio says he built open-source AI developer tools with over 6.8k GitHub stars; education and employers not listed.

technical_complexity.rationale: A DOM-aware toolbar that feeds context to coding agents is moderate engineering; the later IDE and multi-agent orchestration are harder.

defensibility.rationale: Open source toolbar is easy to copy and rely on third party agents; community stars and distribution are the main assets.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Comparison pages dated 2026 show Cursor's own visual editor competing with the toolbar; no dated launch source was found.

market_need_then: AI coding agents were growing fast in 2025 and the toolbar attracted 4,800 stars and 130,000 downloads soon after launch according to a launch-era announcement.

branding.domain_note: Uses stagewise.io; stagewise is a registered trademark of stagewise GmbH per the site.

identity.logo: Round logo image used in the README, otherwise undescribed
identity.voice_and_tone: Simple and direct with model sovereignty messaging

branding.community_and_virality: Open source repo with over 6,000 GitHub stars and an active Discord; launched on HN and YC Launches.

brand_strength.rationale: Open source stars and community gave awareness, but the product positioning changed several times and the name is generic.

outcome_analysis: stagewise grew from an open source browser toolbar into a frontend agent in July 2025, then an open-source agentic IDE, and now the Klex Bots digital coworker product. The open source repo drew over six thousand stars quickly, which is the main traction signal, but public funding beyond an unverified 500 thousand dollar aggregator figure was not found and the product direction has shifted repeatedly.
notes: The 500K pre-seed figure appears only on aggregators (VCBacked, standout.work), so it is unverified and not a round. The site lists TwentyTwo Ventures, Blast Club and Teuto Seed Club as backers but no round details were found. yespress.io profile could not be opened (safety check rate limited). No dated competitor source near April 2025 was found, so the list is empty. Completeness pass: the 500K pre-seed in 2025-09 is recorded from aggregators (VCBacked, FundedIQ, standout.work). A yespress profile instead shows 130K at seed as of 2025-08, which conflicts and is not recorded. No press source found.
